extra_quotes: In this work, we employ the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (pBTE) to calculate temperature depth profiles in semi-infinite Si with varying spectral distributions of surface heat generation, which represents the spectrum of phonons injected across the transducer/substrate interface, and examine how this distribution influences app.

We further simulate TDTR phase signals for an Al/Si structure with systematically varied interfacial phonon transmission spectra and fit them using a conventional multilayer Fourier model with app as one of the free parameters.
